'When this hits, create an Embodiment of Earth token.' Earth Action - Attack (Rosetta).

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT is the standard hit trigger dispatched to the attack card itself; an attack ACTION card is not an ATTACK_REACTION, so the ability lives on the card's own ON_HIT. No conditions - the token is created on every hit, unconditionally.

TOKEN: CREATE_TOKEN reads 'token'/'token_name'/'token_type'/'token_slug' interchangeably (effect_types.py:1942-1948) and create_token slugifies the display name, so 'Embodiment of Earth' -> embodiment_of_earth. The display-name spelling matches the SHIPPED pen/oath_of_oak_yellow.json, pen/laden_with_earth_red.json and flr/sigil_of_sanctuary_blue.json, which proves it compiles and routes. json/tokens/embodiment_of_earth.json already exists; no destination override because default zone routing (from the token template's subtypes) is correct for an Embodiment ally token. count defaults to 1 ('an ... token') and player defaults to SELF (the controller).

No printed keywords on this card, so nothing was deliberately left unauthored. Sibling colours earth_form_red/blue carry identical text and sit in other batches - same shape applies to them. No gaps found in this card's text.
